summary: Single-lag autoregression: each step is a damped echo of the previous step plus white noise. The φ parameter controls how much memory the series keeps.

ranges.phrase: Strongly anti-persistent — the series flips sign cycle to cycle (φ negative and large in magnitude).
Mildly anti-persistent — alternation tendency at the lag.
Effectively memoryless — observations sit close to white noise; AR(1) gains little over a constant mean.
Mild persistence — short-horizon forecasts beat the climatology by a small but real margin.
Moderate persistence — the next step strongly resembles the last; forecasts are credible at short horizons.
Near-unit-root — the series barely mean-reverts; long-horizon forecasts have wide CIs.
